ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Defense Evasion Via Rename Of Highly Relevant Binaries
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed binary often used by attackers or malware leveraging new Sysmon OriginalFileName datapoint.

sequences.query: (process_description = "Execute\ processes\ remotely" OR process_product = "Sysinternals\ PsExec" OR (process_description = RGX("^Windows\\ PowerShell") OR process_description = RGX("^pwsh")) OR (process_original_file_name = "certutil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cmstp\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "IE4UINIT\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "mshta\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msiexec\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msxsl\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "powershell\_ise\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "powershell\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "psexec\.c" OR process_original_file_name = "psexec\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "psexesvc\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "regsvr32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "rundll32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "WerMgr" OR process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ie4uinit\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msxsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psexec64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PSEXESVC\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wermgr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")))
